name: administer_thrombolytics
description: Administer thrombolytic therapy (tPA/tenecteplase) for acute ischemic stroke, STEMI, or massive pulmonary embolism within the therapeutic window

dose_per_kg.description: Dose per kg body weight in mg/kg

patient_weight_kg.description: Patient weight in kg for dose calculation

door_to_needle_min.description: Time from arrival to drug administration in minutes

contraindications_checked.description: Whether all contraindications have been verified absent

when_to_use: Acute ischemic stroke within 4.5 hours of symptom onset
STEMI presenting within 12 hours when primary PCI unavailable
Massive PE with hemodynamic instability when thrombolysis indicated
Stroke patient who cannot receive mechanical thrombectomy
STEMI with door-to-balloon time expected to exceed 120 minutes

examples.query: Ischemic stroke onset 2 hours ago, NIHSS 18, giving alteplase 0.9mg/kg IV
STEMI patient, cath lab not available, giving tenecteplase
